# Guardian

A guardian appointment for a minor child. Supports testamentary, court-appointed, shariah court, community-appointed, and religious court appointments. Guardianship structures include individual, collective, rotating, and family council determined

Source: [`v3/guardian.json`](../../v3/guardian.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/guardian.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this guardian appointment within the INHERIT document |
| `personId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Person.id of the guardian being appointed |
| `personIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced person |
| `childPersonId` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Reference to the Person.id of the child this guardian is appointed for |
| `childPersonIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced child person |
| `role` | one of `primary`, `secondary`, `substitute` | yes | The guardian's priority in the appointment |
| `appointmentType` | one of `testamentary`, `parental_responsibility`, `court_appointed`, `shariah_court_appointed`, `community_appointed`, `religious_court_appointed` | yes | How this guardian was appointed |
| `guardianshipStructure` | one of `individual`, `collective`, `rotating`, `family_council_determined` | | The structure of the guardianship arrangement |
| `familyCouncilDecisionRef` | `string` | | Reference to the family council decision that appointed this guardian, if the appointment was council-determined |
| `conditions` | `string` | | Conditions on the guardianship — when it takes effect, any restrictions, or circumstances under which it lapses |
| `notes` | `string` | | Free-text notes about this guardianship appointment |
| `organisationId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Organisation.id if the guardian is an institutional care provider. Mutually exclusive with personId |
| `organisationIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced organisation |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |
| `dependantType` | one of `minor`, `adult_with_disability`, `adult_with_incapacity` | | The type of dependant this guardian is appointed for. Extends guardian beyond minors to cover adult dependants |
| `guardianshipModel` | one of `individual`, `family_council`, `collective`, `extended_family`, `rotating`, `court_appointed`, `custom` | | The cultural or legal model of guardianship. Differs across legal traditions — individual appointment (common law), family council (West African), collective care (South Asian extended family), court-appointed (civil law) |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
